scripts.prove: cd lean && lake build QueryV2 && out=$(lake env lean Audit.lean) && echo "$out" && ! echo "$out" | grep -q sorryAx
scripts.vectors: cd lean && lake build vectors && lake exe vectors > ../vectors/filters.json && lake exe vectors grammar > ../vectors/grammar.json && lake exe vectors paths > ../vectors/paths.json && lake exe vectors values > ../vectors/values.json && lake exe vectors dates > ../vectors/dates.json
scripts.vectors:check: cd lean && lake build vectors && lake exe vectors | cmp -s - ../vectors/filters.json && lake exe vectors grammar | cmp -s - ../vectors/grammar.json && lake exe vectors paths | cmp -s - ../vectors/paths.json && lake exe vectors values | cmp -s - ../vectors/values.json && lake exe vectors dates | cmp -s - ../vectors/dates.json || (echo 'vectors/ is stale: run pnpm vectors' && exit 1)
scripts.test: TZ=UTC node src/check-matcher.ts && TZ=America/New_York node src/check-matcher.ts && node src/check-grammar.ts && node src/check-sqlite.ts
